data.summary: Octavia is primarily a support-focused Warframe with significant damage amplification capabilities. Her survivability is limited compared to other roles, but her ability to replenish energy for allies makes her a valuable support. She has minimal crowd control and stealth options, focusing instead on enhancing her team's effectiveness through buffs.
